additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396034-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002803] Ooo CRM:01811000517
additional_info.body:
Hello Michael,
I hope you're doing well.
We have analyzed the logs and noticed that the outlets go out of order after the
NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
environment variable is set to
0
, which disables certificate verification for TLS/HTTPS connections. This setting makes the connection insecure by allowing untrusted certificates, which could be causing issues with the connection.
Could you kindly confirm if the server’s SSL/TLS certificates are correctly configured and up-to-date?
Thank you for your attention to this matter. If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
